title: research: exact QQ16 consumer budget obstruction under centre-64 law
body:
## Summary

Adds `research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit/`, an exact independent audit of the recursive-price budget for the pinned `CONSERVED-QQ16` `F0 + B_1_2` pair and #2707 decoder under the unchanged centre-64 coverage law.

The source-pinned F/B profiles average to 2,428 rank-one children per call. The decoder contributes 336 rank-one children across two calls, producing the #3181 profile `{1:2596,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}`. At the selected `kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000`, the verifier removes the eight rank-eight children and relaxes their 64 mass units into rank-51 idle children. Even this favorable relaxation has an exact rational moment lower bound above `100009/100000` at the selected exponent.

This is a scoped necessary-budget obstruction for that fixed profile and coverage law. It does not establish a physical F17 consumer, an exact cap root, a global barrier, a changed-coverage result or a new selected kappa.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -B research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit
```

All three commands passed locally at base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. The registered replay reports `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit outcome=completed`.

## Review focus and limits

Please check the profile reconstruction, the exact atanh/log and positive Taylor lower bounds, and the rank-51 favorable relaxation. The open physical caller, retention, routing, movement and F17-consumer obligations remain outside this package. No selected full historical replay or formal-kernel proof was run.

The exact #3181 README used for its profile premise is retained in compressed form and checked against its source blob/SHA256 at head `80fc72d14546088e9fce3c06dc12bc67270da0af`.

Credit the `CONSERVED-QQ16` producer lineage, ywz65/#2707, dcharb78/#3181, and the selected coverage-ceiling authors. No independent human review is claimed.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-consumer-cap-audit`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
